name: runway-codemirror-bundle
description: Self-hosted CodeMirror 6 bundle for the Runway tenant page editor. Built with esbuild into an IIFE exposing window.RunwayEditor; the output (codemirror.min.js/.css) is committed under runway-app/src/main/resources/static/vendor/ and served at /__assets/vendor/. node_modules is NOT committed — run build.sh to reproduce.
